dict.string: DualAspectCamera needs access to the rear camera to capture simultaneous 16:9 and 9:16 4K video.
DualAspectCamera needs access to the microphone to record synchronized audio for both video streams.
DualAspectCamera needs permission to save finalized horizontal and vertical videos to your Photo Library.
DualAspectCamera needs Photo Library access to export your recorded 16:9 and 9:16 videos.
